non_claim_boundary: Repository-local coupling-refinement ruling execution only; no scientific adequacy claim.

criterion_1_tightened_coupling_confirmed.description: Coupling state must be TIGHTENED from packet output

criterion_2_seam_coherence_fires.description: Seam coherence transition must be observed

criterion_3_ledger_artifact_fires.description: Ledger artifact state change must be observed

criterion_4_correlation_witness_material.description: Correlation witness must materialize between seam and ledger

criterion_5_no_contradiction_with_blocke.description: Tightened coupling must not contradict the retained blocker-authority relationship
criterion_5_no_contradiction_with_blocke.authority_contract_preserved: If coupling tightens blocker-to-authority mapping, contract holds

possible_rulings.condition: all five criteria satisfied AND no contradiction with authority contract
possible_rulings.interpretation: Tightened coupling sufficient to elevate revised blocker definition to authoritative standing

possible_rulings.condition: four or more criteria satisfied OR minor gap remains
possible_rulings.interpretation: Coupling improved but insufficient for full authority promotion; revised def remains secondary-strengthened

possible_rulings.condition: fewer than four criteria satisfied OR contradiction with authority contract
possible_rulings.interpretation: Coupling refinement does not close gap sufficiently; blocker definition remains unfit for authority

declaration.fail_closed_rule: Default to COUPLING_REFINEMENT_NOT_FIT_FOR_AUTHORITY_USE unless all criteria explicitly satisfied
declaration.layer_description: This is the terminal decision layer in the 12-turn diagnostic chain. No further execution below this layer until ruling resolves.
